text.p: Chrysler Corp is trying to buy Rover's small car division, including the Mini and Metro, from Germany's Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW), The Times newspaper reported in its Tuesday edition.

"Executives from Chrysler have inspected Rover production facilities with the consent of Rover," The Times reported. "Chrysler technicians are working on plans to integrate Rover models into the Chrysler product range, according to Chrysler insiders."
The paper said a Rover spokesman confirmed Chrysler's interest but said the advances were not welcomed.
A Chrysler spokesman was quoted by the paper as saying, "At this moment there are no discussions in this respect."
